gascityCockpit.notifications.enabled.markdownDescription: Master switch for native notifications. When off, no toasts are shown for escalations, tool-approvals, or mail.

gascityCockpit.notifications.escalations.markdownDescription: Show a warning toast when an agent needs attention — a session crashes, strands, is quarantined, fails to start/drain, or an order/request fails.

gascityCockpit.notifications.approvals.markdownDescription: Show a toast when an agent pauses for a tool-approval or asks a question, with inline Allow/Deny for tool-approvals. Aggregated across every running city.

gascityCockpit.notifications.mail.markdownDescription: Show an info toast when new mail is sent on the fleet. Covers all fleet mail traffic — disable if it is too chatty.

gascityCockpit.notifications.approvalPol.markdownDescription: How often (seconds) to poll `/v0/city/{city}/pending` for new approvals as a backstop, in addition to polling immediately after each session change.
